page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.large is a general-purpose instance belonging to the ecs.hfg7 family. It is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB core utilizing hyper-threading. The instance features dedicated CPU allocation with a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, 8.0 GB of system memory providing 4.0 GB per core, and no local storage. Networking is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance asymmetry between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression all scoring in the average tier. However, multi-core and memory-intensive tasks show significant limitations. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and Geekbench multi-core scores fall into the bottom 10% tier. Similarly, database operations, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations are constrained, placing in the bottom 10% of benchmarked systems.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 3.3 GHz clock speed, this instance offers a predictable hardware profile for lightweight workloads. However, its low resource density and poor multi-core scaling make it less suitable for parallel processing, heavy database operations, or memory-intensive applications. It is best positioned for single-threaded tasks, basic text processing, or lightweight general-purpose workloads that do not require local storage or high memory bandwidth.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.large is a general-purpose instance featuring 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. It utilizes a KVM hypervisor with dedicated CPU allocation but includes no local storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Performance benchmarks indicate a notable contrast: single-core CPU execution and single-threaded compression tasks achieve average tier results, whereas multi-core scaling, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall into the bottom 10% tier. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic text processing, and general-purpose workloads with low memory and parallel processing demands.
